O11 DYNAMIC EVO
Mid-tower chassis with two modes: Normal Mode/ Reverse Mode
Feature multi-directional power button and movable IO module
Front and side tempered glass panels for components and RGB display
Supports up to 3x 360 radiators and a maximum of 10 fans
Offers 9 storage drives mounting space
Dual-chamber layout with hooks friendly cable management compartment
Number of PSU supported : 2
Five optional accessories: Vertical GPU Kit / Upright GPU Kit / Additional I/O kit / Front Mesh Kit / Top I/O Kit

THE MODERN BLACK
THE MODERN BLACKThe O11 Dynamic series classic tinted glass and brushed aluminum panel are once again combined in proper proportion. ● Brushed Aluminum● Black Coated Mesh Panel● Tinted Tempered Glass
THE PURE WHITE
The Pure WhiteFulfill your dream’s all-white build with a completely white chassis, down to the smallest detail. ● White Coated Mesh Panel● Clear Tempered Glass● Aluminum with white powder coating● Snow White Interior● Silver screws● Light Grey Rubber Grommets● White Dust Filter
THE HARBOR GREY
THE HARBOR GREYPresenting an all-new color option with grey coated aluminum and darker tinted tempered glass panels.● Grey Coated Mesh Panel● Dark Tinted Tempered Glass● Black Interior● Aliminum with harbor grey powder coating● Light Grey Rubber Grommets● Black Feet
VERSATILE ORIENTATIONWith only a few steps, the O11D EVO can be flipped in reverse mode to experience a seamless front and side tempered glass showroom view on the right side of the chassis.
Normal Mode
Reverse Mode
EXQUISITE, YET FUNCTIONALFollowing the style of the O11 Dynamic series, the aluminum panels feature an updated fine mesh which provides an optimal ratio of airflow and dust filtering.
INNOVATIVE AND FLEXIBLE CONFIGURATIONFeaturing a modular design, the O11D EVO offers many configuration potentials when making use of optional kits, both for air cooling and water cooling.
AIR COOLINGUNRESTRICTED AIRFLOW The more direct the airflow, the better the cooling performance. Thanks to the upright GPU kit and the front mesh kit, which makes the addition of 3 extra fans at the front possible, the O11D EVO can provide powerful and direct airflow to the GPU and the CPU.
AIR COOLINGUPGRADED VERTICAL GPUAIRFLOW The upgraded vertical GPU kit provides more room for bottom-mounted fans and radiators to increase the cooling capability and efficiency of the O11D EVO. Users can either mount the GPU vertically at the lower position which provides 50mm of clearance at the bottom of the chassis, or the upper position for 90.5mm of clearance.
Lower Position
Upper Position
CUSTOM WATER COOLINGSUPREME THERMAL CONTROLWith the upright GPU kit, users can move their water-cooled GPU next to the motherboard. This opens up the main chamber of the chassis, allowing simpler and more efficient tube runs to reach the components, and creating a restriction-free chimney-style airflow that allows the top and bottom radiators to perform more effectively.
SPACIOUS COOLING SUPPORTThe O11D EVO features sufficient space to accommodate 3x 360mm radiators, and up to 10 fans.
NORMAL MODE​REVERSE MODE​
MASSIVE STORAGE CAPACITYMultiple easily accessible storage mounting points are provided to support up to 9x SSDs or 6x HDDs + 3x SSDs.
❶Side Drive Tray2.5” SSD × 4 or 3.5” HDD × 2
❷Cable Management Bar2.5” SSD × 2
❸Drive Cage2.5” SSD × 3 or 3.5” HDD × 2 + 2.5” SSD × 1
❹Bottom Fan Bracket2.5” SSD × 4 or 3.5” HDD × 2
Mounting points for a 60mm fan are provided on the hard drive cage, located in the second chamber, to improve the temperature of hard drives. The same location can be used to mount a fan hub.
CLEAN LOOKThe O11D EVO keeps the front panel as clean as possible with a multi-directional power button that can be pressed from both the front and the side of the chassis.
PERSONALIZED ARGB LIGHTING STRIPThe front panel LED strip features 7 built-in lighting effects which can be controlled via the M button. An 8th mode is available to enable motherboard software synchronization or L-Connect control.
Turn off the LED strip : Press M button for 3 seconds in 8th mode.
Connect to UNI HUB
Connect to motherboard
FRIENDLY BUILDING PROCESSEASILY REMOVABLE PANELSThe new mechanism to mount the side panels simplifies the process to reach the interior of the case by eliminating the need to first open the top panel.
Note: It is recommended to fix ❶ ❷ the two glass panel top screw during transportation.
FRIENDLY BUILDING PROCESSEASILY REMOVABLE PANELSThe new mechanism to mount the side panels simplifies the process to reach the interior of the case by eliminating the need to first open the top panel.
Note: It is recommended to fix ❶ ❷ the two glass panel top screw during transportation.
STRUGGLE-FREE FAN BRACKETSWhile each fan bracket features a quick-release design, they can be fixed to the chassis via a straightforward process.
Top Fan BracketRemove the two screws
Bottom Fan BracketRemove the thumbscrew
The side bracket can be oriented in two ways to provide more clearance for fan/radiator combinations next to the motherboard.
Side Fan BracketRemove with quick latch
Inner Scenario
Outer Scenario
EFFORTLESS CABLE MANAGEMENTThe O11D EVO optimizes the user’s ability to cable manage their system with a dual-chamber design and a removable bracket.
RELOCATABLE I/O PORTAt the bottom of the chassis, the I/O module can be relocated to 3 different locations without the use of any tools.
LOCATION 1The default mode can be reached from the front.
LOCATION 2Without any tools needed, the I/O module can be moved to the left side of the chassis.
LOCATION 3Flip the chassis and change the position of the I/O to the right side for a PC in Reverse Mode.
LOCATION 4Optional Accessory—Top I/O Optimized for PC located on the floor, the top I/O additional accessory moves the chassis I/O at the top.
OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES ADDITIONAL I/O PORTSDouble the number of USB ports for a total of 4 × USB 3.0 Type-A and 2 × USB 3.1 Type-C with the additional accessory.
Note: To fully utilize 2 x USB 3.1 Type C ports, the motherboard needs to have 2 built-in headers.
POTENTIAL FOR DUAL PSUThe drive cage can be removed to make place for a second PSU, or be switched to a lower position.
ANTI-SAG BRACKET FOR PERFECTLY HORIZONTAL GPUThe GPU anti-sag bracket is included for displaying hardware through the seamless front and side tempered glass panels.
GB-001Compatible with ATX or E-ATX motherboard
IN COLLABORATION WITH DER8AUERIn continuation of the O11D family, LIAN LI has collaborated with Der8auer and the community to finalize the O11D EVO design. Thanks to his contribution, a LIAN LI badge with De8auer’s name is provided. Users can place it on the cable management bar in their desired orientation.
OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES
VERTICAL GPU KITBlack / WhiteShow off the GPU and increase airflow at the lower or upper position according to the clearance needed at the bottom.
UPRIGHT GPU KITBlack/ WhiteHolds thin and thick GPUs next to the motherboard for unrestricted chimney-style configuration.
ADDITIONAL I/O KITBlack/ WhiteIncrease the number of ports with an additional USB 3.1 Type-C and two USB 3.0 Type-A.
FRONT MESH KITBlack/ White/ GreyReplaces the front glass panel with a mesh panel and support brackets for up to 3x120mm or 2x140mm fans at the front.
TOP I/O KITBlack/ White/ GreyEnables PC placed on the floor to have top accessible IOs.
4- SLOTS VERTICAL GPU KITVG4-5-V4X / VG4-5-V4WSupports up to 4 slots GPU at vertical mounting position to show off in most of LIAN LI cases.Includes PCIe 5.0 riser cable for seamless connectivity.
